newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia's Hansapank Q1 net profit soars.
newsitem.headline: Estonia's Hansapank Q1 net profit soars.

text.p: Estonia's largest bank, Hansapank, said on Friday that first quarter net profit rose to 96.4 million, a 163 percent rise from the same period in 1996.
Hansapank's market share in Estonia by total assets at the end of February was 25.5 percent, the bank added in a statement.
During the first quarter the bank earned 207.6 million kroons in revenue, an increase of 92.9 percentage.
Some 37.1 percent of total revenue was received from net interest income, 39.1 percent from trading income and 23.8 percent from fees and commissions and other income.
Hansapank's assets grew 23.6 percent to 6.85 billion kroons.
During the period, deposits increased by 484.2 million kroons or 14.7 percent. The net loan portfolio was 3.44 billion kroons, a growth of 6.9 percent from the beginning of the year.
Loan loss provisions came to 47.8 million or 1.4 percent of the total loan portfolio, the bank added.
